name: Summer Snow Day
source:
Spend your summer in a small snowy town in this Dating-Sim Murder Mystery. Meet new people and perhaps fall in love! A series of grisly murders throw a wrench into the romance, and now YOU have to solve them! Make FREQUENT choices and play mini games to catch the killer and fall in love!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3191370/Summer_Snow_Day/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这款融合了恋爱模拟与谋杀悬疑要素的作品中，前往一座白雪皑皑的小镇度过你的夏日时光吧。结识新朋友，说不定还能邂逅真爱！然而一连串骇人听闻的凶杀案打乱了浪漫的步调，如今必须由你亲自破案！做出频繁的抉择、挑战趣味小游戏，揪出真凶并坠入爱河吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3191370/Summer_Snow_Day/]Steam[/url]]
